nodes.label: Owner scoped customer DTO
nodes.rationale: Owner must derive from session; DTO strips vehicle, driver, and device internals.

nodes.label: Shared approval queue
nodes.rationale: Customer creation writes into the same B2 approval repository, avoiding disconnected datasets.

nodes.label: Target plus tolerance
nodes.rationale: Submitted temperature range derives from configurable target plus/minus tolerance.

nodes.label: Completion shared mutation
nodes.rationale: Completion writes shared history, frees driver and vehicle, and updates B2/B3.

nodes.label: Role based visibility
nodes.rationale: Separate menus and forbidden routes; customers and drivers cannot see fleet-wide internal data.

nodes.label: Trip completion verdict
nodes.rationale: Verdict derives from final sensor temperature and shipment range; out-of-range completion requires reason.

nodes.label: In memory authentication
nodes.rationale: Registration, token, password changes, and auth session reset on reload; no backend session.

nodes.label: Reset token lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Reset tokens are single-use, expire at boundary, and all old tokens are invalidated after reset.

nodes.label: Frozen food scope
nodes.rationale: Only frozen food; exclude pharmaceuticals, hardware names, and certification claims.

nodes.label: Mock reference clock
nodes.rationale: Mock time is 30/10/2026 14:32; relative timestamps derive from this clock.

nodes.label: Shipment assignment constraints
nodes.rationale: Assign only free driver and capable free vehicle; rejection requires reason.

nodes.label: Temperature range validation
nodes.rationale: System bounds -25 to -15 C, min < max; default -20 to -18 C.

nodes.label: Temperature severity
nodes.rationale: Within 1 C of boundary is near threshold; outside by at least 2 C is critical.

nodes.label: Driver acknowledgement
nodes.rationale: Driver acknowledgement records receipt and note but leaves dispatcher alert open.
